messages:
Sam (CS): heads up — Acme reported a regression after yesterday's quant rollout. They say summaries are hallucinating and token lists are truncated. High priority, customer is blocked.

Priya (SWE): can you paste the exact prompt + before/after outputs so ML can triage quickly?

Sam (CS): pasted from customer (sanitized):

Prompt: \"Summarize Q1 cashflow and list any named counterparties mentioned.\"

FP16 (before rollout):\n\"\"\"
Total cash inflow was $4.2M. The main counterparties mentioned are Bank A and Vendor X. No material irregularities found.
\"\"\"

INT8 (after rollout, auto-int8-v2):\n\"\"\"
Total cash inflow was $4.2M. The list includes Bank A, Vendor X, and \u200b. There is unexpected note about \"John Doe\" which isn't in the input. Also several lines cut off mid-token like \"transac\" and \"counter\".\n\"\"\"

Sam (CS): They included a reproducible curl call and request id. Repro (sanitized):

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"galactica-7b\",\"quant_profile\":\"auto-int8-v2\",\"inputs\":\"<prompt>\",\"stream\":false}' \
  -H \"X-Request-ID: acme-req-20250408-01\"
```

System logs (from our side):
```
[2025-04-08T02:13:59Z] quantizer: applied profile auto-int8-v2 on model galactica-7b
[2025-04-08T02:14:01Z] serving: warmup complete, canary traffic=20%
[2025-04-08T02:22:00Z] serving: promotion to 100% rollout completed
[2025-04-08T02:24:31Z] user: acme-req-20250408-01 latency=412ms tokens=78
```

Diego (ML Eng): thanks, this looks like a classic quant-induced instability. The hallucination + token truncation pattern often maps to LayerNorm/scale quant noise or per-tensor clipping mismatch. Do we have stored calibration stats for auto-int8-v2 and the calibration dataset used?

Priya (SWE): deployment notes say auto-int8-v2 used opportunistic calibration on a small telemetry corpus (1k samples). We rolled canary 20% -> promoted to 100% at 02:22 UTC. deploy-bot posting details:

deploy-bot: Deploy: quant-profile auto-int8-v2 activated on hosted-default at 2025-04-08T02:22:00Z (canary 20% -> 100%) by Priya

Marta (Oncall): I'm attempting to repro on staging with the same model binary + quant profile. Repro steps:
- Pull model galactica-7b:sha@f2c3
- Apply quant profile auto-int8-v2
- Run curl above pointing at staging

Observed: outputs match customer's INT8 behavior — missing suffixes, occasional spurious token insertion. Per-token probs show higher variance in LayerNorm outputs. I can attach a tiny sample of logits if needed.

Diego (ML Eng): ok plan: 1) Immediately stop further promotions and rollback hosted to previous quant-profile (auto-int8-v1 or fp16 baseline) for critical customers; 2) create dedicated repro/eval set using customer's prompts + our internal prompt set; 3) re-run calibration with per-channel symmetric scaling and an extended sample set (10k) and test; 4) if regression persists, revert to fp16-by-default and ship improved int8 later.

Priya (SWE): I can trigger a rollback. Which route should we use? granular (only route Acme) or global rollback?

Diego (ML Eng): route critical customers to fp16 fallback ASAP (feature flag + route rule). Global rollback preferable if we see widespread reports. For now do targeted rollback + global mitigation flag to treat quant_profile=auto-int8-v2 as opt-out.

Sam (CS): told customer we can pin them to fp16 variant or apply a temporary flag. Acme wants a full rollback for their workspace and will accept a pin until we verify fixes. They asked for ETA on a permanent fix.

Marta (Oncall): action items added to incident INC-2025-0452. I'll run the targeted rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback: quant-profile auto-int8-v2 -> auto-int8-v1 for workspace acme at 2025-04-08T02:47:12Z by Marta

Priya (SWE): created PR with routing rule to pin workspaces with severity=high to fp16_fallback. Also opened ticket ML-1883 for calibration + testing.

Diego (ML Eng): for the follow-up fix we'll: 1) re-calibrate with per-channel min/max and outlier clipping; 2) add test harness with natural-language unit test set and perplexity/regression thresholds; 3) run a small canary (5%) and evaluate quality metrics (ROUGE/BLEU + manual evals) before any broad rollout.

Sam (CS): customer confirmed rollback mitigated the issue for their test cases. They've asked for a postmortem and a timeline. I'll keep them posted and request any additional examples.

Priya (SWE): summary for triage: rolled auto-int8-v2 too fast, insufficient calibration set. Mitigation: targeted rollback + fp16 pin. Next steps assigned to ML-1883 and INC-2025-0452. ETA for repro/fix: 3 business days tentative.

Diego (ML Eng): tagging @eng-ml for visibility. Will follow up with an experimental branch and share logs.

Sam (CS): thanks team. I'll close the escalation once customer signs off. :thumbsup:
